title: REQ · The Boy's Room world and bedroom content
summary: Author world.yaml and bedroom.yaml with opening dialogue and six objects
description: Context: content directory does not exist. Desired behavior: world the-boys-room starting in bedroom; the boy asks 'I don't know what to do next. What should we do?'; objects bed, bookshelf (search opens hidden door via flag secret_door_open), desk, old computer, window, door, each with inspect/push/search/leave actions where relevant. acceptance_criteria: Given the content, when loaded and validated, then validateWorld returns no errors.
Given the opening dialogue node, when read, then its text equals "I don't know what to do next. What should we do?" spoken by the boy.
Given the scene, when read, then objects bed, bookshelf, desk, old-computer, window and door exist.
Given the bookshelf search action, when performed, then flag secret_door_open becomes true.
technical_constraints: Schema must match types in backend/game/src/state/types.ts
